verdict.rationale: Bruno's privacy posture is strong. It is offline-only with no cloud sync, account or login (bruno-docs-48, bruno-docs-8). The vendor says it has "zero visibility into your requests," and Bruno AI uses bring-your-own-key with no data routed through Bruno servers (bruno-docs-39). However, none of this mentions usage telemetry or analytics, or any setting to turn them off. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of what telemetry or usage tracking exists, a documented opt-out setting or flag (GUI or CLI), and independent verification that no usage tracking occurs.
